data.content_ref: inline:The 'Epistemic Boundary' hypothesis abstracts SRC_002 and SRC_003 into a single principle: the relative reliability of a panel versus an expert depends on whether the 'objectively verifiable outcome' is a first-order property (observable) or a second-order property (synthetic). This relation is refuted if a non-expert panel outperforms an expert on a task requiring high-dimensional synthesis of non-linear variables.
